plan.hypothesis: Position build/unwind and trader positioning provide information absent from price/volume/premium/funding features.

metrics_availability_assumption.stock_change_endpoints: Exact timestamps; missing intermediate snapshots do not invent or change stock endpoints.
metrics_availability_assumption.raw_warmup_policy: Clamp to fixed 2023-11-09 coverage; incomplete first 4h10m drops from both paired fits.

plan.paired_ablation: Per model, both feature arms share exact training timestamp/label hashes and identical inference rows; same estimator, parameters, seed and settled-label purge.
plan.selection: Eight augmented rules only; discovery >=500 decisive, >=100 each asset, >=58% win and positive net; maximum Bonferroni-Wilson lower over eight then lexical ID.
plan.baseline_policy: The selected candidate is compared only with its same-model/threshold/regime base60 control fitted in the same paired cache.
plan.incremental_evidence: Separate historical flag requires selected-minus-control weekly net lower95 >0; profitability alone is not evidence that metrics add information.
plan.execution_robustness_gates: Selected 2bp adverse-entry net positive in validation, confirmation and continuous later history; each stressed bankroll must still fund one stake.
plan.later_disclosure: All eight augmented candidates and eight matched controls, including continuous2bp stresses; no later reselection.
plan.feature_policy: Read-only verified existing base feature store and completed verified metrics archive; never download or rebuild in this runner.

limitations: Prior rounds already explored 113 configurations on this history; new information does not make the historical holdout pristine.
Archive record time plus ten minutes is an explicit lag assumption; these files do not prove contemporaneous publication or absence of revisions.
Missing/stale/invalid metrics reduce the common population of both feature arms; no values or missing endpoints are filled.
Positive strategy profit alone does not show incremental metrics value; inspect the paired net interval and separate evidence flag.
All16 later candidate/control results are disclosed for audit; only eight augmented discovery candidates participate in selection.
Scores are not calibrated probabilities; overlapping targets and structural regime changes limit statistical confidence.
Minute index prices proxy actual contract strike/expiry; 2bp stress and known unavailable dates do not cover every execution risk.
No production code, live model, alert, order, GitHub remote or server was changed.
